answer_1.quote: Text generation paradigm sequentially generates arguments using auto-regressive LMs with the help of prompts.
answer_1.outputs: Structured event arguments in a predefined format (e.g., attack_event = Attack(attacker=[...], ...))

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance with two metrics following previous work : Argument Identified (Arg-I) denotes the head word of an argument matches the human annotation, and Argument Classified (Arg-C) means an argument is correctly classified into its annotated role as well. We report them using F1 score.
